claims.claim_text: The indexed Lawerence B. McFaddin has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment entry recorded as Lawrence B. McFaddin.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed and Army names differ only in the Lawerence/Lawrence spelling and share a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from a unique protected-identifier match and closely aligned full names; both spellings remain explicit.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes wartime identity context but not an immediate pre-OSS assignment or civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The printed index spelling remains primary. Army grade and occupation codes are not converted into employer evidence.
